notes:
CLASSify Desktop v1.0.0 — Initial stable release.

Features:
- CSV upload with automatic column-type detection (int, float, bool, categorical)
- Column configuration modal with missing-value handling (drop, constant, synthetic)
- Class column mapping with drag-drop string-to-integer interface
- Supervised classification: RandomForest, XGBoost, GradientBoosting, HistGradientBoosting, NeuralNetwork, LogisticRegression, KNeighbors, Bagging, SGDClassifier, TabPFN (addon)
- Unsupervised clustering: KMeans, SpectralClustering, HDBSCAN
- Parameter tuning via Optuna with configurable search ranges
- SHAP feature explainability with per-row waterfall plots
- Cross-validation with repeats and margin-of-error reporting
- Visualization suite: ROC curves, confusion matrices, SHAP beeswarm, feature heatmaps
- Live training log streaming via SSE
- Run history with archived results, logs, and visualizations
- Rerun with previous settings pre-populated
- Add-on system for torch-gated models (TabPFN, SDV) with async install and progress tracking
- In-app update checker
- Local-first: all data stays on your machine (SQLite + filesystem)
